fear_cycle.name: The Fear Cycle
fear_cycle.when: When writing content that needs emotional urgency
fear_cycle.principle: Emotion → Action. All marketing boils down to making the viewer feel an emotion that compels action.

curiosity_loop_hides_fear.name: Curiosity Loop Hides the Fear
curiosity_loop_hides_fear.when: When hooks need emotional depth without feeling manipulative
curiosity_loop_hides_fear.method: Start with something curious that implies fear. Fear slides to subconscious but they hear it.
curiosity_loop_hides_fear.example: 'Nike's being sued for all these runners' injuries' — curiosity opens, fear lands subconsciously

territory_compression.name: Territory Compression
territory_compression.when: When positioning or refining a personal brand
territory_compression.principle: Magnetic brands shrink to grow — become more valuable for fewer people first
territory_compression.application: Instead of 20 topics, talk about 2. Instead of everyone, talk to someone specific.

change_how_they_think.name: Change How They Think
change_how_they_think.method: Reframe their perspective in 30 seconds while watching. They don't have to do anything — attribute value in real time.
change_how_they_think.why_powerful: More powerful than tactics (which require them to act)

fandom_funnel.name: Fandom Funnel & Superfans
forces: One-of-One Expertise: Use trust anchors — results, experiments, case studies, hours spent
Territory: Who you stand for and the specific slice you occupy
Consistency: Show up with the same frame every time
Intimacy: Make them feel like they know you personally
fandom_funnel.source: Callaway Marketing — BY FAR, The Smartest Way to Build A Personal Brand in 2026

key_tactics: Magnetic brands shrink to grow — narrower territory, stronger connection
Emotion → Action. Find the emotion that compels the specific action you want
Fear slides to subconscious when wrapped in a curiosity loop — they feel it without noticing
Change how they think in 30 seconds is more powerful than giving them a tactic
Infuse one-of-one expertise in the second/third line (after hook) using trust anchors
The Light Phone example: same fear hook → 2.3 million views
Most people speak in generalities → nobody feels it's for them. Get specific.
